source_name: MNB – Közvetítők keresése (intermediary / agent register)
why_relevant: Separate registers for money-market (Hpt.) and insurance (Bit.) intermediaries, including dependent/independent agents and cross-border agents. This is the agent-register layer of the cell: it names the distribution channel population behind banks and PIs.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök archívuma (incl. PSZÁF-era)
why_relevant: Archive of superseded supervisory instruments, including those issued by PSZÁF before its 2013-10-01 merger into MNB. Essential for reconstructing how a supervisory expectation evolved, and for spotting the pre-2013 institutional lineage that direct search misses.

source_name: MNB – Magyar székhelyű intézmények határon átnyúló tevékenységei (outbound passporting lists)
why_relevant: Lists Hungarian payment institutions and credit institutions that passport services into other EEA states — identifies which HU payments actors are regionally expansionist, a direct lead-generation list.

source_name: MNB – Speciális adatbázisok (special registers)
why_relevant: Index of niche registers: BEVA-eligible participants, EU covered bond label issuers, prospectus registers, authorised security printers, training organisations, cross-border fund manager agents. Each is a small named-actor list useful for enumerating adjacent payments/banking suppliers.

source_name: MNB legacy supervisory web archive (mnb.hu/archivum/Felugyelet)
why_relevant: Frozen mirror of the old PSZÁF/supervisory site tree, organised by institution type (hitelintézetek, biztosítók, pénzügyi vállalkozások). A map of historical sources and terminology not reachable from the modern navigation.

source_name: MNB archive – Felügyelt intézmények / Piaci szereplők (legacy PSZÁF-era register pages)
why_relevant: Archived register structures from the PSZÁF/early-MNB era. Valuable for historical baselining — reconstructing which institutions existed in earlier years and how categories were named before the current taxonomy.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti szabályozó eszközök archívuma + mnb.hu/archivum (legacy PSZÁF-era instruments)
why_relevant: Historical ajánlások/vezetői körlevelek (including PSZÁF legacy) needed to establish baselines and to tell 'withdrawn' from 'never existed' when a current instrument disappears from the live listing.

source_name: NKFH — Társhatóságok (co-authority map) and general consumer-protection authority
why_relevant: Official map of which Hungarian authority handles which consumer complaint type, confirming that financial consumer-protection breaches route to the MNB rather than the general consumer-protection authority. Prevents mis-attribution when building the enforcement actor model, and identifies boundary cases (e.g. commercial practices of non-financial firms selling credit-adjacent products).

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Tagjaink (banking association member list)
why_relevant: Curated list of 40+ member institutions with individual member profile pages (including infrastructure firms such as GIRO Zrt.), each carrying contact and website details — a fast route from register name to the actor's own disclosure channels.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Szakmai kapcsolatok (EBF / EMF affiliations)
why_relevant: Names the European umbrella bodies the Hungarian association channels its lobbying through (European Banking Federation, European Mortgage Federation). Those umbrellas publish consultation responses that carry the Hungarian position upward — a reliable route to positions never published domestically.

source_name: Közbeszerzési Hatóság – online services & databases hub
why_relevant: Single index page enumerating all official procurement databases and online services (notice search, contract database, KDB decisions, CPV code lists, registers). The most efficient snowball hub for discovering further authoritative endpoints in this cell.

source_name: Magyar Fintech Szövetség — Tagok (member list) and annual Fintech Report
why_relevant: Directory of the Hungarian fintech population (startups through mature firms, incubators, accelerators) plus a board roster naming affiliated companies (Barion, BlockBen, Tőkeportál, HOLD, Ergománia). The annual English-language Fintech Report doubles as a regulatory-change survey of the ecosystem.

source_name: 10times – Hungary conference index (banking/payments filter)
why_relevant: Generic global event aggregator useful only as a coverage net for HU banking/payments events (e.g. International Payment Forum Budapest) that local sources miss; low reliability on dates and must be verified against organiser sites.

source_name: Arcanum Digitheca — Magyar Közlöny archive 1945–2019
why_relevant: Full-text searchable historical archive of the gazette back to 1945. Not needed for forward-looking compliance dates, but essential when reconstructing the history of a long-lived obligation (e.g. tracing an Hpt. provision back through the 1996. évi CXII. regime) or dating a repealed requirement.

entity_name: Baker McKenzie Global Financial Services Regulatory Guide
source_name: Baker McKenzie Global Financial Services Regulatory Guide — Hungary chapter
why_relevant: English structural map of who regulates Hungarian banking/payments and which decrees apply (e.g. MNB Decree 36/2017 on payment services, PSD2 implementation). Excellent onboarding/actor-map reference and a pointer to primary legal instruments.

source_name: EY Law Hungary (IFLR1000 profile as entry point)
why_relevant: EY was the one Big Four firm for which no Hungarian financial-regulatory newsletter surfaced in either language during this pass; the IFLR1000 profile confirms EY Law Hungary exists as a ranked practice and is the entry point for locating its (presumably subscription-gated) alert channel.

source_name: Felvi.hu — 'Állásportálok' directory (higher-education careers service)
why_relevant: Public-sector-maintained directory of Hungarian job portals and career resources; a second, independent pointer inventory to validate the board list and surface graduate/entry channels through which banks staff junior compliance and reporting roles.

source_name: Hetpecsét Egyesület / HTE szakmai előadásanyagok (DORA prezentációk)
why_relevant: Magyar információbiztonsági szakmai egyesületek konferenciaanyagai gyakran tartalmazzák a DORA hazai megvalósításának gyakorlati részleteit (MNB-előadók slide-jai), amelyek máshol nem publikáltak.

source_name: HR Portal — 'Állásoldalak' / 'A legjobb álláskereső oldalak' (pointer to the HU job-board landscape)
why_relevant: Maintained, dated inventory of Hungarian job portals with market-share commentary (profession.hu ~90%, CVOnline #2, Jobline #3, Dreamjobs, Jófogás, Zyntern). This is the map that keeps the board list current as portals appear/disappear — plus HR Portal itself reports on sector hiring and organisational change.

source_name: HVCA — Magyar Kockázati- és Magántőke Egyesület (Hungarian Private Equity and Venture Capital Association)
why_relevant: ~70-member association of VC/PE investors plus legal, advisory and financial-services firms, with a browsable member directory by category. Both a pointer to the fintech-investor population and an occasional commenter on fund/investment regulation.

source_name: instantpayments.hu – Hungarian instant payments resource hub & GIROInstant Simulator
why_relevant: Practitioner-curated index linking HCT Inst rulebooks, Message Implementation Guides, Technical Connectivity Guide, EACHA interoperability framework and ISO 20022 message definitions; excellent snowball source for the exact Hungarian technical artefact names. Note: appears to be a Google Sites-hosted third-party hub, not an operator site — treat as pointer, verify against giro.hu/mnb.hu.

source_name: Kyndryl — Customer stories directory
why_relevant: Global infrastructure-services vendor with a searchable customer-story directory; the class of source (managed-services provider reference pages) is exactly where Hungarian bank infrastructure/outsourcing engagements surface, given MNB outsourcing rules require documented provider arrangements. Hungary-specific entry not yet confirmed.

source_name: Közadatkereső / kozadat public-data search (linked from kormany.hu footer)
why_relevant: National public-interest-data catalogue referenced from the kormany.hu document archive footer; a route to ministry datasets and publication schemes that may index draft-legislation and consultation records not surfaced by the portal's own filters.

source_name: Legal 500 / Chambers & Partners – Hungary banking, finance and capital markets rankings
why_relevant: Directory rankings are the cleanest way to enumerate the full universe of Hungarian banking/finance interpreter firms (and the named partners who author alerts) before crawling each one. Chambers publishes downloadable Hungary PDFs listing every ranked firm by band.

entity_name: Magyar Közlöny Lap- és Könyvkiadó / MKIFK
source_name: Magyar Közlöny Lap- és Könyvkiadó / MKIFK — publisher and webshop
why_relevant: The publisher operating both magyarkozlony.hu and (via MKIFK Magyar Közlönykiadó és Igazságügyi Fordítóközpont Zrt.) the Nemzeti Jogszabálytár. Relevant for establishing provenance, authenticity (digital signature scheme), licensing terms for reuse, and for purchasing/archival access to back issues via webshop.mhk.hu.

source_name: NGM administrative-consultation mailbox (kozigazgatasiegyeztetes@ngm.gov.hu)
why_relevant: The address published on NGM draft packages for submitting comments; its presence in a document is a reliable machine-detectable marker that an item is a live NGM consultation with a deadline, and it identifies NGM as the responsible ministry for a draft.

source_name: paytech.events – TechShow X Budapest 2026 listing and 2026–2027 fintech/payments conference calendar
why_relevant: English-language aggregator that describes the Hungarian event's agenda themes (instant payments/AFR evolution, ISO 20022, EU Instant Payments Regulation, DORA) and attendee mix including MNB regulators; useful as a discovery index for events not indexed in Hungarian sources.
